contents: sub-band layout, rate-conversion filter parameters (up/down factors, tap counts, cutoffs and the Kaiser beta; the filters, FFT windows and twiddles are computed from them in prepare()), and the per-band detector constants (noise floors, excess coefficients, refractory frames, operating thresholds, candidate window, stationary-fluctuation table)
runtime_decision: Compiled into the DSP module as fixed values for the three band detectors.

fitted_values.values: noise floors, excess coefficients and the stationary-fluctuation table (49 levels)
fitted_values.fitted_on: Monte Carlo runs on synthetic noise (stationary-fluctuation table: seeds 74000000 + level index)
raised from its validation optimum so that every stationary-noise condition of the synthetic false-alarm check meets the specification

fitted_values.values: operating thresholds Mid 0.24 and High 0.44; candidate window 1 s and minimum ratio 1/4
fitted_values.fitted_on: chosen on the Slakh2100-redux validation split and Groove MIDI validation fold (312 tracks) for the best F-measure (selection only)

selection_only_sets.set: Slakh2100-redux validation split and Groove MIDI validation fold
selection_only_sets.used_for: choosing the operating thresholds, the candidate window and the minimum ratio
